meta.title: Settings

seedanceCredits.availableBalanceTip: Available credits = Seedance credits + regular credits remaining after estimated regular model usage, usable for seedance-beta models.
seedanceCredits.refundNotice: Seedance credits are only for seedance-beta models on AiToEarn. If AiToEarn prevents you from using those models, the unused portion is fully refundable.
seedanceCredits.faceUploadTip: Clear real frontal faces may have a lower pass rate. Masking or blurring key facial areas such as the eyes before upload can significantly improve success.

appearance.desc: Theme and language only affect this device. They apply right away, nothing to save.

notify.desc: Get the slow jobs, like AI material generation, pushed to your phone when they finish. Push goes through Bark, using your own server and key.
notify.channelDesc: Open Bark on your phone and copy the push URL and key it gives you. Leave it empty and push is silently skipped — nothing else is affected.
notify.enabledDesc: Turn this off and nothing is pushed at all, not even through the server's default channel. Your URL and key are kept.

envFallback.title: The server has a default channel
envFallback.user: You've set your own URL, so notifications go through it. The server's default channel only covers you when you haven't.
envFallback.env: You haven't set your own URL, so notifications currently go through the server's default channel — you get them without configuring anything. Fill in the URL below to use your own.
envFallback.off: Receive push is off, so not even the server's default channel is used. Nothing is being sent right now.

notify.urlDesc: The push URL from Bark, like https://your-domain/your-device-key/. Public addresses only — loopback and private network addresses are rejected. Leave it empty to not use a channel of your own.
notify.keyDescSet: Already set ({{masked}}). Leave it empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
notify.keyDescEmpty: The value of the bark-key request header. Once saved it is only ever shown masked.
notify.keyPlaceholderSet: Leave empty to keep the current key
notify.groupDesc: Your phone groups notifications under this name. Leave it empty to use AiToEarn.
notify.rulesDesc: When to ping you. More rules will land here later; there is one for now.
notify.rulesDisabledHint: Receive push is off, so none of the rules below apply — off means nothing is sent at all, not even through the server's default channel.

draft_ready.title: AI finished generating material
draft_ready.desc: Get a ping when the current round of material generation is done, so you don't have to watch the page.

notify.testDesc: Sends a real notification to your phone using the saved settings. The title says it's a test. Your key never comes back to the browser, so the test always uses what's saved: save first, then test.
notify.testDirtyHint: Save your changes first, then send the test.
notify.testEnvHint: This will go through the server's default channel.
notify.testOffHint: Receive push is off. Turn it on and save before testing.
notify.testEmptyHint: No channel available yet. Fill in the Bark URL and key, then save.
notify.testSuccessDesc: A test notification should have arrived on your phone. If nothing showed up, check that Bark is allowed to send notifications.

testFail.urlInvalid: Invalid address: it isn't a complete URL, or the protocol isn't http/https. Check it and save again.
testFail.urlBlocked: Address not allowed: it points at loopback or a private network, so the server won't call it.
testFail.urlUnresolvable: Hostname can't be resolved: no IP was found for that domain. Check it for typos.
testFail.timeout: Timed out: Bark didn't answer within 5 seconds, the network may be blocked.
testFail.unreachable: Couldn't connect: the server failed to reach that address. Check the domain, the port and your firewall.
testFail.unauthorized: Wrong key: Bark rejected the request (401/403). Enter the key again.
testFail.rejected: Rejected: Bark answered with an error status. Check the device key in the URL.
testFail.ruleDisabled: That rule is switched off. Turn it back on and try again.
testFail.notConfigured: Nothing configured yet: fill in the Bark URL and key first.
testFail.unknown: It didn't go through. Try again in a moment.

urlError.malformed: That isn't a complete URL — include https://
urlError.protocol: Only http and https addresses are allowed
urlError.private: Loopback and private network addresses aren't allowed. Use a Bark URL reachable from the internet.

groupError.tooLong: That group name is too long

error.urlInvalid: That Bark URL isn't valid — check that it's complete
error.urlBlocked: That address isn't allowed: it points at loopback or a private network, so the server won't call it
error.urlUnresolvable: That hostname can't be resolved — check it for typos
error.keyRequired: Enter a Bark key when you set a Bark URL
error.notConfigured: Bark isn't set up yet — enter the URL and key, then save
error.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Try again in a moment.

login.desc: You need to sign in to use this part.
login.hint: Sign in and you can edit your profile and notification settings here.
